title: Create educational application foundation

requirements.text: Create a landing page that introduces the educational platform with a hero section, feature highlights, and call-to-action
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays a welcoming hero section
Key features or benefits of the platform are highlighted

requirements.text: Implement a course listing view where users can browse available educational courses with title, description, and enrollment status
acceptanceCriteria: Course list displays with title and description for each course
Users can view all available courses
Enrollment status is visible for each course

requirements.text: Create backend data models for courses including course ID, title, description, instructor, and enrollment list
acceptanceCriteria: Course type is defined in Motoko with all necessary fields
Courses can be stored and retrieved
Data structure supports instructor information and student enrollment

requirements.text: Implement user enrollment functionality allowing authenticated users to enroll in courses
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can enroll in available courses
Enrollment status is persisted in the backend
Users can view their enrolled courses

requirements.text: Create a cohesive visual theme with warm, inviting colors (avoiding blue and purple), clean typography suitable for learning, and an accessible layout that encourages engagement and focus
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses warm, educational tones consistently throughout the app
Typography is legible and appropriate for extended reading
Layout promotes focus and reduces visual clutter

constraints: Use Internet Identity for user authentication
All backend logic must be implemented in a single Motoko actor
Frontend must use React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
nonGoals: Advanced course creation tools for instructors
Real-time chat or messaging between students

required: Hero section background image showing a bright, welcoming learning environment with books and natural light (hero-learning.dim_1200x600.png)
Icon representing course enrollment with a friendly academic theme (course-icon.dim_128x128.png)
